channel.description: Latest articles from Points in Case (pointsincase.com)

item.title: This Ain’t My First Rodeo—Even If My Pronouncing “Rodeo” Like “Rodeo Drive” Suggests Otherwise
item.description: What, because I talk funny? Because I called your saloon a coworking pod? Because I palo santoed your game of Texas hold ‘em?

item.title: Everyone in This Coffee Shop Is Having a Meet-Cute Except for Me
item.description: What makes the spills so frequent, the meets so cute? Is it the cheap, lopsided mugs?

item.title: Automated Texts I’ll Receive on My Deathbed
item.description: A Nebraskan tire center I used once on a road trip seven years ago: We’re feeling a little deflated today, and wheel miss you as a valued customer.

item.title: What Your AI Jargon Says About You
item.description: Existential Risk: You testified before Congress that this technology could end humanity. You also had a product launch that Thursday and it went great.

item.title: It’s Possible Jay Gatsby Is Abusing GoFundMe
item.description: I urgently need your help after my latest extravagant shindig has left my estate in shambles. Look here, old sports.

item.title: Oh Boy, My Favorite Celebrity Is on a Humiliation Ritual Press Tour
item.description: Call me desensitized, but the only thing that really keeps me tapped in for My Favorite Celebrity is to see them risk it all—day after day, for months on end.

item.title: I Have to Fire Our Project Manager on the Same Day He Brought His Dog Into the Office
item.description: Who’s a good boy? Who’s a precious lil pup? Yes you are! Yes you are! Hmm, oh, yes, Mark, hello. Sorry, I was just saying hi to your dog Pepper.

item.title: Ominous Bumper Stickers
item.description: If You’re Reading This, You’re Paying More Attention To The Road Than I Am

item.title: Schrödinger’s FOMO
item.description: If you do go out, you’ll immediately start thinking about when you can leave. If you don’t go out, you’ll immediately start wishing you had.

item.title: NASA Contingency Plan: In the Event an Artemis II Astronaut Is a Werewolf
item.description: NASA is almost certain that none of you are werewolves. However, to ensure the safety of our new lunar missions, we must consider every eventuality.

item.title: An Introduction to Cubicles & Corporations: The Tabletop Role-Playing Game Your Dungeons & Dragons Characters Play
item.description: How will you endure the ancient ritual of the Office Birthday—standing motionless while colleagues sing at you and maintain eye contact?

item.title: No, Son, Rash’kar’lagratar Isn’t the Magic Word
item.description: No, son. That is magic as speaking it will hurl back any unclean shades which try to approach you.

item.title: How to Style Curly Hair in Fourteen Perfectly Reasonable Steps
item.description: Look up “detoxifying.” And “curl pattern.” And “Keri Russell in Felicity,” before she cut her hair, just so you have an unattainable ideal.

item.title: I’m the Previous Tenant of Your Apartment and I’ve Left This “Junk” Behind for a Reason
item.description: You'll notice there's just one light bulb in this 3-pack of light bulbs. That's the point. Ask yourself: Do you see two missing, or one remaining?

item.title: Six-Course Tasting Menu for an Italian Restaurant with No Toilet
item.description: Join us for an intimate five hour journey with our tasting menu that changes seasonally while our bathroom policy does not.
